plan.freeze: Save derivation/regex/helper/fixture hashes before V0.2 Index construction or execution.
plan.monotonicity: Adding a globally scoped end-of-haystack assertion can only remove matches: L(V0.2) subseteq L(V0.1). Historical negative carry-forward is conditional on byte-exact transformation.
plan.representative_sample: Lowest eight token IDs, plus lowest ID in each present empty/JSON-whitespace/non-whitespace class; selection sorted, deduplicated. Exhaustive classification establishes absence as well as presence.
plan.root_cause_gate: A: END_ANCHOR_ABSENT (or independently established ineffective global anchor) AND B: at least one non-empty non-JSON-whitespace allowed token with an actual next state, in each of the two diagnostic fixtures. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; no V0.2.
plan.suffix_method: Use the saved V0.2 M1 accepting state; independently tokenize each suffix and query transitions from that state. No EOS advance; no repetition of the base fixture.
plan.token_classification: Classify every non-EOS allowed token by the exact string conversion used to build Vocabulary. JSON whitespace is only space/TAB/CR/LF. Record all IDs and all classified representations. Query Index.get_next_state without advancing the diagnostic Guide.
plan.transformation: V0.2 bytes = b'(?:' + exact V0.1 bytes + b')\z'; no other change.

release_facts.api_inspection: Read installed Index/Guide method documentation without constructing any Index, Guide, tokenizer or model.
facts: Final-state detection and ordinary token transitions coexist (lines 117-143).
EOS is inserted into final-state allowed transitions (lines 170-175), but next_state on EOS returns None (lines 216-219).
Start anchoring is not end-of-input anchoring; a final state need not expose only EOS.

static_inspection.method: Inspected exact UTF-8 regex; scanned escaping/character classes for $, \z, \Z. No assertion found means no global end assertion. No inference from token count.
